name: MHP
verdict: Management and IT consultancy owned by Porsche AG, of which Volkswagen AG indirectly holds 75.4%; Qatar Holding LLC holds 10.4% of Volkswagen AG’s capital and 17.0% of its voting rights. Porsche signed the sale of MHP to Tata Consultancy Services in August 2026.
note: Main and shirt sponsor of 1. FC Heidenheim. Rating note: concern, rated by today’s owner. The link: MHP is a subsidiary of Porsche AG (mhp-porsche-ownership); Volkswagen AG indirectly holds 75.4% of Porsche AG’s share capital (porsche-vw-ownership); Qatar Holding LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Qatar Investment Authority, the State of Qatar’s sovereign wealth fund, holds 10.4% of Volkswagen AG’s capital and 17.0% of its voting rights (qatar-holding-vw-stake, qatar-holding-qia-ownership, qia-government-of-qatar-ownership). Multiplied along the chain, that is about 7.8% of Porsche AG (10.4% × 75.4%): 5% or more, without control. The record: Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch on migrant workers under Qatar’s kafala system (qatar-migrant-worker-abuse-2025). Porsche signed the sale of MHP to Tata Consultancy Services on 24 August 2026; the sale, subject to regulatory and antitrust approvals, had not closed when this was rated. When it closes, MHP gets re-rated by its new owner. Rated concern on 2026-10-01 (maintainer decision).

why.text: MHP is a subsidiary of Porsche AG, which signed an agreement on 24 August 2026 to sell it to Tata Consultancy Services. Volkswagen AG indirectly holds 75.4% of Porsche AG’s share capital, and Qatar Holding LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Qatar Investment Authority, the State of Qatar’s sovereign wealth fund, holds 10.4% of Volkswagen AG’s subscribed capital and 17.0% of its voting rights. Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch report that migrant workers in Qatar still faced labour abuses and exploitation under the kafala sponsorship system in 2025, despite reforms.
